meta.notes: sound_event is what plays, here the vanilla cat track. A bare string must be a registered sound event such as a vanilla one; for new music from your own sounds element use the object form { "sound_id": "msm_examples:<event>" }. description is shown when the song starts, length_in_seconds is how long the jukebox counts as playing and comparator_output (0 to 15) the comparator signal. Any item with a jukebox_playable component can play it: /give @s minecraft:music_disc_13[minecraft:jukebox_playable="msm_examples:cat_remix"].
